label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — Math.random() generates insecure entropy; the resulting token (rememberMeKey) is stored in a session cookie and sent over HTTP, enabling session hijacking. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — User-supplied cookie values (from request.getCookies()) are echoed directly into the HTML response without sanitization (response.getWriter().println(...)). Both represent real vulnerabilities on their respective paths.

evidence.note: Math.random() used for session token generation (insecure)
User cookie values echoed to response without encoding
